connectionReference.description: Connection to Microsoft Planner via Microsoft Graph API for retrieving and updating tasks

listPlans.description: List all plans the user has access to

getPlan.description: Get details of a specific plan

listBuckets.description: List all buckets in a plan

listTasks.description: List all tasks in a plan

getMyTasks.description: Get all tasks assigned to the current user

getTask.description: Get details of a specific task

getTaskDetails.description: Get additional details of a task including description and checklist

planId.description: The ID of your default Planner plan

groupId.description: The Microsoft 365 group ID that owns the plan

filterAssignedToMe.description: Only show tasks assigned to the current user

includeCompleted.description: Whether to include completed tasks in results

setupInstructions: 1. Sign in with your Microsoft 365 work or school account
2. Authorize the Planner connection when prompted
3. Select the plan you want to connect to (optional - you can view all plans)
4. The connection will automatically use your Microsoft 365 credentials
